findings.title: Overly broad filter
findings.body: The filter treats any span with a `span.type` attribute as a GenAI/LLM span, whatever its value. `span.type` is a generic key that other instrumentations also set, for example Datadog-style values like `web`, `sql`, `http` or `cache`. With this change, ordinary HTTP and DB spans from those libraries will pass `isGenAiOrLlmAttributeSpan` and be exported. That defeats the purpose of the filter. Match only the Claude Code values instead, e.g. `span.type` in `interaction` / `llm_request`, as `expandClaudeCodeSpanAttributes` already does. Consider adding a negative test case such as `{ "span.type": "web" }`.

Overly broad filter
The filter treats any span with a `span.type` attribute as a GenAI/LLM span, whatever its value. `span.type` is a generic key that other instrumentations also set, for example Datadog-style values like `web`, `sql`, `http` or `cache`. With this change, ordinary HTTP and DB spans from those libraries will pass `isGenAiOrLlmAttributeSpan` and be exported. That defeats the purpose of the filter. Match only the Claude Code values instead, e.g. `span.type` in `interaction` / `llm_request`, as `expandClaudeCodeSpanAttributes` already does. Consider adding a negative test case such as `{ "span.type": "web" }`.
